tournamentRules.formatKnown: Competitors Cup at 1,500 CP or less, with an organizer-provided team-list workflow

doNotAssume: Do not label the qualified-competitor list as confirmed registration or attendance.
Do not infer private age or treat the open competition as an adult-only guarantee.
Do not treat the empty organizer shell as a final pool assignment or pairing source.

requirements: Confirm an exact structured results feed and permission to poll it.
Review competitor aliases against the final roster and quarantine every mismatch.
Keep last-known-good scores and require an owner-reviewed official final source.

officialQualifiedList.pageDescription: Discover which competitors earned an invitation to compete at the 2026 Pokémon World Championships.
